changelog:
cnc-quote-skill v1.0.0 is the initial release—AI-powered CNC machining quote platform with risk detection and multi-channel integration.

- Core quote engine with rule-based pricing and AI risk detection
- Supports material optimization suggestions
- Integrates with QQ Bot, Email, and API channels
- Includes a self-learning RAG-based system with real quote data
- Easily configurable for multiple manufacturing scenarios
summary: AI-powered CNC machining quote system with risk detection, material optimization, and multi-channel integration. Built for OpenClaw ecosystem.
